constraints.constraint: The objects must be pencil cases.
constraints.A_evidence: The open zippered case has narrow slots for pens or pencils and mesh storage pockets.
constraints.B_evidence: The elongated zippered cases include open examples visibly holding writing instruments.

constraints.constraint: There must be four pencil cases.
constraints.A_evidence: Only one open case is shown.
constraints.B_evidence: The top panel shows six cases in a row; the lower panels show additional views of a blue case.

constraints.constraint: The pencil cases must have different colors.
constraints.A_evidence: A single black and gray case is shown, with no collection of differently colored cases.
constraints.B_evidence: The row includes dark blue, cyan, green, gray, pink, and purple cases.

constraints.constraint: The pencil cases must be lined up.
constraints.A_evidence: One open case is displayed alone, rather than multiple cases in a line.
constraints.B_evidence: The top panel places the cases side by side in a row.

judgment.reason: The instruction requires four differently colored pencil cases lined up. A shows only one case, while B lines up six cases rather than four.
